verdict.rationale: Kick documents only the server role: it exposes its own MCP server so external assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor can query and update Kick data. Nothing in the evidence shows Kick acting as an MCP client that lets users plug in third-party MCP servers for its own agents to use. Because Kick runs built-in AI agents, this axis plausibly applies, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
